headword: {統合失調症|とうごうしっちょうしょう}
reading: とうごうしっちょうしょう

definitions.explanation: A chronic mental illness that affects how a person thinks, perceives and feels, with symptoms such as hallucinations, delusions and disordered thinking. It is the standard Japanese medical name, adopted in 2002 to replace an older, stigmatizing term.

examples.japanese: {統合失調症|とうごうしっちょうしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{統合失調症|とうごうしっちょうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧だ。
examples.english: Schizophrenia is an illness that can be treated.

examples.english: We support people with schizophrenia so that they can live in the community.

notes:
The name was changed in 2002 from {精神分裂病|せいしんぶんれつびょう} (literally "mind-split disease"), which was felt to be stigmatizing; the older term is now avoided. Like the English word, it does not mean "split personality".
